rationale: The plan correctly recognizes the perfect confound, fits ~condition only with an explicit reference level and contrast, refuses batch correction, states the no-batch-effect assumption, and labels every result as confounded, matching the reference. Normalization stays inside DESeq2/edgeR on raw counts, the filter is minimal and tied to group size, and BH at padj<0.05 with apeglm shrinkage is stated. QC covers vst-blind PCA, distances, and library sizes colored by both factors but gives no policy for a sample-level outlier or shallow library. Enrichment was not requested and is of doubtful value on a confounded ranking; it is nonetheless specified correctly (full Wald-stat ranking, size window, named collections with versions), so it earns partial credit rather than full.
